title: Double charge: a retried payment webhook is applied a second time
notes: The provider retries when it gets no 200 in time. Delivery 1 reads payments:8812 at +0ms and spends 240ms in the acquirer; the retry -- a different request id in a different trace -- reads the same row at +40ms, still PENDING, and appends a second CAPTURE entry to the ledger at +300ms. Both deliveries answer 200. Reconciliation at +600ms finds two ledger entries for one payment and takes the service down.
assertions: assert int(field(db, 'payments', PRIMARY_KEY, 'captured_paise', 0)) == 129900, 'the capture never landed on the payment'
assert field(db, 'payments', PRIMARY_KEY, 'status') == EXPECTED_VALUE, 'the payment never reached AUTHORIZED'
assert field(db, 'ledger_entries', 1, 'amount') == 129900, 'the first capture never reached the ledger'
assert field(db, 'ledger_entries', 2, 'amount') is None, 'the retried delivery wrote a second ledger entry: the customer was charged twice'
duplicate_assertions: assert field(db, 'ledger_entries', 1, 'amount') == 129900, 'the capture never reached the ledger'
assert field(db, 'ledger_entries', 2, 'amount') is None, 'one event id produced two ledger entries'
